g.text: Upon mounting, the SceneCanvas requests the scene
referenced by the current URL query parameters
JSON object built from the parsing of the
scene's SVG. The SceneElement instances aggregate
references to the React Component that will
render them on the screen and the properties
that must be provided for the construction of
the React Components. The SceneElement instances
are used on calls to React.createElement at
the end of the Scene Construction Sequence.
Dispatch an action about the loaded scene
is the base class for all
the widgets visible on the scene. Widgets
that have a corresponding React component
